title: Set up vitest projects, test kit and coverage gate
description: The test foundation this tree builds on, already implemented: vitest.config.ts defines four projects (unit/guards/build/e2e) run by one vitest run, vitest.live.config.ts isolates the network tier so pnpm test can never reach it, package.json gained test:watch/test:unit/test:e2e/test:live, tsconfig includes the live config, tests/setup/ holds the repo fixture and recording doubles, tests/guards/ covers all three guard scripts plus the husky hooks, tests/build/artifact.test.ts runs tsup into a temp dir and imports the artifact, tests/testkit.test.ts pins the doubles, and tests/scaffold.test.ts pins the current not-implemented stubs. Coverage is v8 with thresholds keyed to src/** (statements 95, functions 100, branches 85, lines 95), proven able to fail at 99. Result: 63 passing + 22 todo in 14 files, src at 97.91% statements.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
